newsitem.title: SPAIN: Spain's ICO issues 43 bln pta 10-year bond.
newsitem.headline: Spain's ICO issues 43 bln pta 10-year bond.

text.p: Spanish official credit agency ICO said on Wednesday it is to issue 43 billion pesetas in 10-year 6.75 percent bonds.
The domestic issue is aimed at retail investors, and bonds have a face value of 10,000 pesetas.
Bids can be presented from 5 to 27 December.

Banks taking part in the syndicate are Argentaria Banco de Negocios, Banco Bilbao Vizcaya, Banco Central Hispano, Banesto, Santander, Caja Madrid, La Caixa, CECA - Ahorro Corporacion, Banco Santander de Negocios, Banco Urquijo and BNP Espana.
The note added that ICO issues are guaranteed by the Spanish State, and it will be listed on the Spanish bourse.
